translations.web: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord Jehovah.
